title: Pathing Plus
description:
Pathing Plus is designed to help you draw better paths (and hopefully make
better pathing decisions as a result).

Features include:

- Use the draw and eraser tools to map out your path - straight lines snap to the path you draw.
- Alternate map views - fit the entire map on screen vertically or horizontally.
- Automatic route analysis: how many elites / fires / events are there on each path?
- Improved gamepad support for the map features (left analog button to switch between draw and eraser tools, right trigger to switch between map views)

Feedback and feature requests always welcome!

Source code and issue tracker:
https://github.com/davekalina/spire2-pathing-plus
changeNote:
v1.0.1 - Guards the last few places a mod failure could have reached the game instead of stopping at the mod.

v1.0.0 - First public release.

Draw a rough path on the map and it snaps to the real routes, counts what each one holds, and lets you compare them side by side. Auto-Path picks the routes with the most elites, fires, shops, events or combats. Three map views, and full gamepad support throughout.

Note for controller players: the right stick scrolling the map needs Steam Input disabled for Slay the Spire 2, or the right stick bound to Joystick Move. Everything else works either way.
